title: Plugins
schemaBehind: Its data is at schema {{have}} and moves to {{want}} when the plugin next runs.
schemaNewer: Its data is at schema {{have}}, newer than this version knows ({{want}}). Install a newer version.
pageEmpty: Nothing on this page for your account.
kicker: What Floorbit talks to: sources, monitoring and add-ons

librenmsAlerts.title: Paste into LibreNMS
librenmsAlerts.desc: LibreNMS: Alerts > Alert transports, a new transport of type API. Turn off Verify SSL unless LibreNMS trusts the agent's certificate, and give the alert rules this transport with recoveries on.
librenmsAlerts.newTokenQuestion: LibreNMS stops getting through until you paste the new token there. Make a new one?
librenmsAlerts.addressUnknown: No browser has reached this agent's front door yet: put in the agent's address in the hall.
librenmsAlerts.off: The port is 0: the agents don't take LibreNMS alerts.
librenmsAlerts.noAgent: No local agent yet: LibreNMS sends its alerts to one.

off.title: Off
off.text: Turn it on to use it.

workingOn.title: Working
workingOn.text: Its agent part runs on {{count}} of {{total}} local agents.

noAgent.title: Needs a local agent
noAgent.text: Its work runs on a local agent in the hall, and none is connected yet.

notRunning.title: Not running
notRunning.text: Its agent part runs on none of the local agents yet. They pick it up on their next report.

warning.title: Needs a look
warning.text: Its agent part warns on {{names}}: see Per agent.

failing.title: Failing
failing.text: Its agent part fails on {{names}}: see Per agent.

perAgent.title: Per agent
perAgent.settingsIntro: Set a value on a tag and every agent with it gets it; set it on one agent only where that machine differs. An agent's own value wins over its tags (the first tag first), and an empty field uses the plugin's settings.

no_agent.label: No agent
no_agent.text: It runs on the local agent, and none is connected.

not_configured.label: Not configured
not_configured.text: On, but it still needs its settings.

receiving.label: Receiving
receiving.text: Data arrives through {{count}} of {{total}} local agents.

missing.label: Not installed
missing.text: Its data is here already. Install the plugin from the Marketplace to change its settings.

builtin.intro: The parts that come with Floorbit. Turn off what your event doesn't use: a part that is off leaves the menus, its pages and API answer "not found", and its background checks stop. Nothing is deleted.
